import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Convert hour_of_day to categorical
credit_fraud['hour_of_day'] = pd.cut(credit_fraud['hour_of_day'], 
                                     bins=[0, 6, 12, 18, 24],
                                     labels=['Morning', 'Afternoon', 'Evening', 'Night'],
                                     include_lowest=True)

# Create a bar plot of transaction types
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=credit_fraud, ax=ax)
ax.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax.set_ylabel('Count')
ax.set_title('Transaction Type Distribution')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram of transaction amounts
credit_fraud['amount'] = pd.to_numeric(credit_fraud['amount'])
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,6))
sns.histplot(credit_fraud['amount'], bins=20, ax=ax)
ax.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount')
ax.set_ylabel('Count')
ax.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, overwrite=True)

# Create a box plot of transaction amounts by fraud status
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,6))
sns.boxplot(x='is_fraud', y='amount', data=credit_fraud, ax=ax)
ax.set_xlabel('Fraud Status')
ax.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount')
ax.set_title('Transaction Amount by Fraud Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, overwrite=True)

# Create a bar plot of hour_of_day by fraud status
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,6))
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud', data=credit_fraud, ax=ax)
ax.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax.set_ylabel('Count')
ax.set_title('Hour of Day by Fraud Status')
plt.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, overwrite=True)
